title: Switch between independent tool environments
expected: project-a selects Node 22; project-b selects Node 24.
Leaving a project restores previous PATH and values; independent terminals keep their own selection.

cases.name: nested-terminal
cases.change: Open both directories in separate activated terminals.
cases.expect: Neither changes the other's tool or APP_MODE.

limitations: Oyzu CLI/build/agent integration is pending; native checks do not prove policy, sandbox, cache, reporting, or release behavior.
